title: Casa Palacio Luxurious 8BR Mansion in Scottsdale
description:
Escape to Casa Palacio, a stunning 8-BR Spanish-style resort estate in Scottsdale for up to 20 guests. This luxury home features a resort pool with a waterslide, hot tub, putting green, and a tennis/basketball court. Perfect for large groups and family gatherings seeking a unique, upscale getaway just minutes from Old Town.
AZ TPT License #21591808
City of Scottsdale License #2038008
review_snippets: The house was very beautiful. There was cameras that was not listed the pool. I did not work and it’s very hot in the room with the pool table and the ACs are locked.

Mary is a professional, prompt and great host. The property is spacious, elegant and rustic all in one. A lot of bathrooms and nice furniture to lounge in. We used the pool and basketball court which was fun. The neighborhood was nice & quiet. Will definitely book this place again if I’m in town!

The house was perfect for what we needed. We had 17 in all (9 adults and 8 children) so needed some space. There was enough rooms for people that kids waking up in the middle of the night didn't wake others! The yard was awesome and kept everyone occupied for the entire stay. Location is great - away from busy streets but can get to grocery / coffee within a couple minutes. Highly recommend staying here - whether it be for a family trip or a friends trip!
Great location for a large family to all stay together. Very spacious. Will definitely book again in the future
